candidates.change_summary: Replace require guard to allow only the contract deployer (owner) instead of depositorAccount, changing who can set the stored L1 block values.
Replace the require guard to check against the declared constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT instead of depositorAccount, enabling the hardcoded address to set values.
Replace require with a check that only allows any caller (no require), removing the restriction so anyone can call and thus potentially change observed state.
Insert assignments that store the provided parameters into the contract's state variables, causing the public getters to reflect the passed values after call.
Change the require condition to a negated form that only rejects the depositorAccount (i.e., allows everyone except the depositorAccount) altering who can update state.
